status: Released for printing as one complete set of four parts for the 1 inch (25.4 mm) square tube. The enclosure back and Pi carrier are byte-identical to R006, so a printed R006 set needs only the new clamp U and clamp bar. Geometry checks pass; physical fit and grip of the new clamp are unverified.
approval: On 2026-11-03, after the 13.35 mm test print, the user corrected the tube to 1 inch on each flat side (relayed by the coordinator).

source.images: clamp images from designs/ultraskelly/src/part_images.py and part_titles.py, run generated/ultraskelly/part-images/r013; enclosure back and carrier images from R006
source.commit: The commit that adds this checkpoint.

clamp-u.stl.part: Clamp U with the dovetail tongue, for the 1 inch (25.4 mm) square tube
clamp-u.stl.orientation: Standing on its lower end, tube opening vertical, dovetail tongue on the back; as exported.

clamp-bar.stl.part: Clamp bar, for the 1 inch (25.4 mm) square tube
clamp-bar.stl.orientation: Flat, with the four screw-head recesses facing up; as exported.

enclosure-back.stl.part: Enclosure back: frame plate, dovetail channel with a 45 degree chamfer, PCA9685 wing and tie tab
enclosure-back.stl.orientation: Standing on its lower end; as exported. Add a 5 mm brim.
enclosure-back.stl.reproduced: The R007 build exports the same mesh moved 6.025 mm along -X with the larger U: equal vertex and face counts, largest vertex difference 2.3e-06 mm after the shift (float32 rounding).

pi-carrier.stl.part: Pi carrier: rail frame with four standoffs on the Pi 5 hole pattern
pi-carrier.stl.orientation: Flat, standoffs facing up; as exported.
pi-carrier.stl.reproduced: The R007 build (generated/ultraskelly/enclosure/r013) exports this file byte-identically.

changes_from_r006: Clamp U and bar resized for a 25.4 mm tube instead of 13.35 mm; same 0.4 mm clearance, 1.5 mm bar take-up, nut slots, blind screw holes, bed chamfers, height and bolt rows.
Dovetail tongue unchanged; the enclosure hangs 6.025 mm further back with the larger U.
Enclosure back and Pi carrier: R006 files, unchanged.

design_guidance.rule: Strength comes mostly from perimeters; most parts need 10 to 15 % infill, rarely over 30 %; thicker walls raise strength more than infill.
design_guidance.change: Clamp 6 perimeters with 25 % infill; enclosure back and carrier 3 perimeters with 15 % infill.

design_guidance.rule: Gyroid infill has equal strength in all directions and a good strength-to-weight ratio.
At least 3 top layers over sparse infill.
Walls thinner than one perimeter (about 0.45 mm) do not print; walls over 0.8 mm print on any printer.
design_guidance.change: Clamp arms back to 10 mm: 1.4 mm beside the bar recesses instead of 0.4 mm.

design_guidance.rule: Overhangs up to 45 degrees print without supports (Prusa allows 45 to 60).
design_guidance.change: 45 degree chamfer under the dovetail block, peaked window tops and teardrop PCA9685 bosses.

design_guidance.rule: Bridges sag unless shorter than 5 mm.
design_guidance.change: Peaked window tops; horizontal holes 5.6 mm or smaller; the 20 mm dovetail cap kept as the one bridge.

design_guidance.rule: Edges on the build plate flare; chamfer them where fit matters.
design_guidance.change: 0.5 mm chamfers on the clamp U tube opening and dovetail tongue at the bed.

design_guidance.rule: Thread-forming screws in thermoplastics: pilot 0.8 x diameter with an entry counterbore; printed holes come out undersized.
design_guidance.change: PCA9685 pilots 2.1 mm (0.84 x 2.5 mm) with 2.9 by 0.5 mm counterbores.

design_guidance.rule: FDM parts are weaker between layers; orient structural parts for their load.
design_guidance.change: Orientations kept: clamp loads run along the layers; the bar takes head pressure across them.

design_guidance.rule: Moving fits start at 0.3 mm clearance.
design_guidance.change: None: the kept 0.3 mm dovetail and 0.4 mm tube clearances agree.

not_covered_by_sources: nut-trap sizes (slots kept at 5.9 by 3.0 mm for a 5.5 by 2.4 mm nut)
screw engagement and boss size in printed parts (PCA9685: about 1.8 x d engagement, 2.2 x d boss)

estimate.method: Not sliced; the Snapmaker Orca command line crashed with the U1 profiles. Per part: side area x walls x 0.45 mm plus flat area x top/bottom layers x 0.2 mm, capped at the solid volume, plus infill in the rest; PETG at 1.27 g/cm3. Time at an average 6 to 10 mm3/s, as on a fast printer such as the U1.

measure_before_printing: Tube: square, 24.5 to 26 mm per side (1 inch is 25.4 mm).
Bare tube: 40 mm for the clamp, with nothing fixed to any of its four faces.
Space: the mount is 104 mm tall, 81 mm wide and 92 mm deep; it hangs behind the tube from 17.5 mm below the clamp to 46.5 mm above it.

envelope_mm.frame: Clamp frame: origin on the tube axis at the clamp lower end; tube faces at +/-12.7.

interfaces.tube: 25.4 mm square tube; 0.4 mm clearance at the sides and back; the bar closes a 1.5 mm gap at the front
interfaces.dovetail: Tongue root 16, tip 22, depth 6, height 40, 0.5 mm bed chamfer; mates the enclosure back channel (0.3 mm clearance)
interfaces.pi: Pi 5 board underside 7.5 mm behind the plate on the carrier standoffs, as on the R004 case

overhangs: Checked on the exported meshes: 45 degree chamfers, peaks and teardrops, holes of 5.6 mm or less, and one 20 mm bridge under the dovetail cap; no supports needed.
robot_clearance: Not assessed. Only the mount size (envelope_mm) and the bare tube length are given.
not_established: the new clamp: printed fit on the 1 inch tube and grip
printed dimensions, the tube and dovetail fits, the nut slots and the M2.5 threads in the PCA9685 bosses
strength of the lighter parts and settings, the clamp grip, and the lock pin under robot motion
M2.5 machine screws in the 2.1 mm printed pilots: the 0.8 x d rule is for moulded bosses and thread-forming screws
Motor HAT spacer height (11 mm estimated) and the AI HAT+ spacer threads
wiring: drawn schematically; cable lengths and the bundle route
print time and filament: estimated, not sliced
